Every picture and sound this mod ships, what each one is for, and where it came from.

The assets

Everything listed here is original to this project. Nothing is copied from another mod, and nothing is extracted from the game.

Where Rimrooms uses one of the game's own pictures or sounds, it names the path and the game provides it while you play — that file is not in this package and is not on this page.

52 drawings and 17 sound cues, 24652 KB in total.

This page is generated from the package itself on every build, so it cannot drift from what actually ships.

How to read the facings column

A building that can be rotated needs a separate drawing per direction. The game mirrors west from east for free; nothing else is free.

one frame identifies a fixed pose or interface icon. The closed journal and Set Gate button need one picture; the journal's reading poses and directional equipment have their own facing sets. Rectangular sets list both pixel sizes because turning them swaps their width and depth.

Sound cues

CueWhat it isLength and formatSound definition
RR_AnalysisCompleteA restrained verification click and short instrument confirmation.1.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_AnalysisComplete
RR_ContractPaidA short receipt-feed mechanism and stamped latch, without a jackpot melody.1.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_ContractPaid
RR_CutoffThrownA heavy switch clack and circuit latch.0.5 s, 48 kHz monoRR_CutoffThrown
RR_FieldRadioA crew member calling in an observation from the field.0.6 s, 48 kHz monoRR_FieldRadio
RR_GateActivateA pressure release over a deep settling motor: the connection's payoff.2.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateActivate
RR_GateCalibrateA short, dry mechanical detent and relay click, subdued enough to repeat at each quarter of a charge cycle.0.6 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateCalibrate
RR_GateEmergencyAn uneven failing motor with separated mechanical impacts, distinct from the current warning cue.2.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateEmergency
RR_GateOpenLoopA quieter four-second repeating motor presence for an open gate.4.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateOpenLoop
RR_GatePowerRiseThe gate pulling on its reserve. Low and rising.2.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GatePowerRise
RR_GateRampDownA descending rev settles into a final latch and silence, giving normal closure a resolved ending.2.5 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateRampDown
RR_GateRampUpAn industrial motor rev climbs and holds its upper speed. The ending stays unresolved; a brief anti-click fade trims the edge.2.5 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateRampUp
RR_GateSpinLoopA repeating low motor hum and periodic pulse for charge-up. Three-second periodic mono loop.3.0 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateSpinLoop
RR_GateWarningSomething is wrong at a gate, or something has come through it. The mod's most-used cue, so it is short and unmistakable.1.1 s, 48 kHz monoRR_GateWarning
RR_JournalFiledPaper friction followed by an archive latch.0.7 s, 48 kHz monoRR_JournalFiled
RR_MarkerSetA small switch click with a brief indicator tick.0.4 s, 48 kHz monoRR_MarkerSet
RR_SectionAssembledTwo fastening strikes followed by a heavier securing latch.0.8 s, 48 kHz monoRR_SectionAssembled
RR_SpatialTellThe space itself behaving incorrectly. Deliberately unlike the other three.1.4 s, 48 kHz monoRR_SpatialTell
